user.strategy_description: Place both sides near mid when spread wide (variation)
user.strategy_long_explanation: Uses orderbook bid/ask spread. Entry spread >8c, place both sides at mid +/-2c. Position market making 0.5% per side. Why work: collect spread. Why fail: adverse selection. Evidence: market making 51% win rate but positive EV from spread.
